import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor

import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Wronskian
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Vandermonde
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.ZMod
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Int.Sum
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Polynomial
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.CancelLeads
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.PDeriv
#check_failure MvPolynomial.taylor_monomial
#check @MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial
#print MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial
#check @MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_monomial
#print MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_monomial
namespace MvPolynomial.TaylorMonomialRaw
theorem universal {σ R A : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A]
    (f : σ → A) (k : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R) :
    aeval (R := R) f (monomial k a) = algebraMap R A a * k.prod (fun j n ↦ f j ^ n) :=
  aeval_monomial _ _ _
theorem inline {σ R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (α : σ → R) (k : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R) :
    (let T : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial σ R :=
      aeval fun j ↦ X j + C (α j)
     T (monomial k a)) = C a * k.prod (fun j n ↦ (X j + C (α j)) ^ n) :=
  aeval_monomial _ _ _
#print axioms universal
#print axioms inline
end MvPolynomial.TaylorMonomialRaw

theorem MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial.{u, v, u_1} : ∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R]
  [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] [inst_2 : Algebra R S₁] (g : σ → S₁) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R),
  (MvPolynomial.aeval g) ((MvPolynomial.monomial d) r) = (algebraMap R S₁) r * d.prod fun i k ↦ g i ^ k :=
fun {R} {S₁} {σ} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S₁] [Algebra R S₁] g d r ↦
  MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_monomial (algebraMap R S₁) g d r

theorem MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_monomial.{u, v, u_1} : ∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R]
  [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] (f : R →+* S₁) (g : σ → S₁) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R),
  (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom f g) ((MvPolynomial.monomial d) r) = f r * d.prod fun i k ↦ g i ^ k :=
fun {R} {S₁} {σ} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S₁] f g d r ↦
  of_eq_true
    (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (MvPolynomial.eval₂_monomial f g)) (f r * d.prod fun n e ↦ g n ^ e))
      (eq_self (f r * d.prod fun n e ↦ g n ^ e)))
